title: RAW Megenberg: attributed cross-kind joining versus both same-kind exclusions under one polarity rule
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Complete Megenberg VII.10 context and its final connected argument supply four explicitly reported joining cells: neither lead-with-lead nor tin-with-tin, but each with the other, alongside reciprocal hardening claims and the author’s withheld knowledge. A prospective finite, gap-free four-clause screen must bind the same predicate, two arguments and polarity across all cells before any complete exploratory reading. No metal word is identified.

design.question: Can one written binary predicate and one written polarity rule preserve both denied same-kind cases and both affirmed crossed cases, while retaining the source attribution and authorial uncertainty, rather than treating reciprocal pairs alone as evidence?

source.work: Konrad von Megenberg, Buch der Natur, VII.10, Von dem Plei
source.edition: Franz Pfeiffer1861; TITUS electronic transcription, KoykaStoyanova1997/JostGippert. Historical claims, not a modern metallurgy protocol.
source.complete_chapter_read: VII.10, printed p481.7–34; heading at7, title at8. Strict UTF-8 decoded raw cache.
source.prospective_argument_unit: Complete final connected argument p481.28–34: authority attribution, relative softness/hardness and both admixture claims, both same-kind joining denials, both crossed joining assertions, Latin-book attribution, and the author’s non-knowledge qualification.
source.boundary_limit: The argument is an explicitly selected complete sentence-run, not a claim that seven printed lines form an original manuscript paragraph, nor a claim to translate the whole lead chapter. The entire chapter was read to preserve context.
source.rights: Raw TITUS HTML or extracted chapter text is not publication payload. Retain only paraphrases, locators, hashes and derived symbolic constraints.

punctuation_and_scope.content: Authority attribution; despite lead being soft and tin hard, adding lead to tin makes tin harder. The sentence ends after the first admixture statement.
The analogous lead-hardening statement on adding tin; ends before the next concessive clause.
Denies lead-with-lead, then tin-with-tin; asserts tin-with-lead, then lead-with-tin; explicitly attributes this to the Latin book.
Author says he does not know this. Its minimum scope is the just-reported joining claim; broader scope is retained as a separate branch.

complete_chapter_context_retained: Lead is compared with tin in nature and gold/silver/copper in heaviness; no measured common-volume calibration is supplied.
Malleability/casting and temporary relief of some pains are asserted; melted brightness darkens again through attributed intrinsic impurity.

Lead and its mixtures are said to deaden sound; melting decreases it, while weather/air is said to increase it more than earth. Do not invent a conserved laboratory mass ledger from these heterogeneous statements.
Its dross retains silver; colour retention, relation to silver and separation during silver refining are stated. Gold association/improvement is denied and a harmful influence on gold is asserted.

The final authority-attributed argument contrasts initially soft lead and hard tin, says adding each to the other makes it harder, then gives the four joining cells and an explicit authorial knowledge qualification.

meaning_kernel.relation: J(x,y): the attributed account permits soldering/joining x WITH y. The first argument is the treated material kind; the second is the with-material role. The wording may concern solder/filler use rather than two finished pieces being joined. Preserve this role ambiguity; no physical portion identity, particular assembly geometry or equality of mixture ratios is inferred.
meaning_kernel.additional_obligations: Preserve the initially soft/hard contrast and both stated hardening-by-admixture clauses. Do not infer equal mixture ratios, identical batches, a quantitative increment or universal hardness averaging.
meaning_kernel.modality: The table is content attributed to a Latin book/authorities. The author says he does not know this; that is not an assertion that all four source propositions are false. A later reading must encode reported content and withheld knowledge, not silently promote it to accepted physical fact.
qualification_scope_branches: NARROW: final knowledge qualification scopes over the immediately preceding joining claim.
BROAD: it also scopes over the preceding admixture/hardening report.
meaning_kernel.scope_policy: Retain both branches unless a further owned source or explicit target scope distinguishes them; do not choose a branch retrospectively to repair a reading.
meaning_kernel.logical_limit: Symmetric and irreflexive on this reported two-kind domain only. No universal joining law, exact chemical composition, modern experimental truth, individual object identity or historical Vorlage claim follows.
meaning_kernel.positive_modality_limit: The positive generic verb is represented as source-stated admissibility, not a guarantee that every joint succeeds. The negative modal claims and the later authorial non-knowledge remain distinct. No omitted flux, temperature or laboratory protocol is invented.

design.why_not_another_reciprocal_pair: AB and BA alone fit direction exchange, conjunction, association and many free stories. The two explicitly denied AA/BB cells make a different finite consequence: a reflexive relation cannot retain all four truth values under the same polarity, and a strict asymmetric comparison cannot retain both crossed affirmations. The attribution and author’s uncertainty add a separate scope duty, not extra negative relation cells.

prospective_target_nomination_before_acc.finite_writer_family: ATOMIC14: Let A,B,R,N be four pairwise distinct exact whole forms. Positive clauses contain exactly the three slots; negative clauses add exactly N. This gives12 explicit whole-group realization patterns. These literal spelling and polarity assumptions are paid exploratory hypotheses, not grammatical facts about Voynich.

The stem/role assignment is hypothetical; GDT915 established association, not this denotation, and GDT916 did not establish new-pair grammar.

rivals_and_nonidentifiability: Swap A and B: exactly the same four-cell pattern. Lead versus tin cannot be identified by this table.

DIFFERENT, XOR on two categories, permitted cross-kind pairing, marriage/compatibility conventions or other symmetric irreflexive relations can share the table. A full source argument and independent meaning binding would be needed to identify SOLDER.
Reverse marked/unmarked polarity while complementing the predicate: an equality-like table can reproduce the surface contrast. The unmarked-positive convention is paid, not recovered by the pattern.
A bare scalar strict comparison fails both crossed affirmations on the same axis; changing axis or time between cells is a different model and requires written scope.
A reciprocal transport description can share AB/BA, but does not by itself assert the two diagonal prohibitions or the material hardening/authorial-knowledge clauses.
Independent lexical statements may express the same source facts. Successful full authoring does not itself establish productive morphology or historical source identity.
SOLDER_WITH(x,aid) versus JOIN_TWO_PIECES(x,y): the four-cell table alone does not choose the physical roles of WITH. A later whole account cannot silently change between these readings.
